name: Heliod's Intervention
oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Destroy X target artifacts and/or enchantments.
• Target player gains twice X life.
blocked_sentences: • Destroy X target artifacts and/or enchantments.

needs.what: a mode-owned target spec (`mode: 0`) whose size is the X announced for the spell (`count: {"x": true}`), so a modal spell's bullet can say "X target artifacts and/or enchantments" and only declare those targets when that mode is chosen
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `count: {"x": true}` is legal on a spell's card-level targets (Pest Infestation, Curse of the Swine), and `mode` is how Abrade gives each bullet its own target, but `loader.targets._check_mode_targets` refuses a mode-owned spec whose count is not a literal or "any" ("a mode-owned target's size must be printed"). Dropping `mode` would demand the artifact targets and the player target together whichever bullet is chosen, and `count: "any"` is not exactly X
